description: This file contains utility functions for memory management and doubly linked list operations used in the FreeType project.

methods.name: ft_mem_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory and zeroes it if size > 0.

methods.name: ft_mem_qalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with error handling, returns NULL if size <= 0.

methods.name: ft_mem_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory and zeroes new part if expanded.

methods.name: ft_mem_qrealloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory with various checks, handles zero and large sizes.

methods.name: ft_mem_strcpyn
methods.description: Copies string with size limit, always zero-terminates.

methods.name: FT_List_Find
methods.description: Finds a node in a doubly linked list by data.

methods.name: FT_List_Add
methods.description: Adds a node to the end of the list.

methods.name: FT_List_Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node at the beginning of the list.

methods.name: FT_List_Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the list.

methods.name: FT_List_Up
methods.description: Moves a node to the front of the list.

methods.name: FT_List_Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over list nodes with a callback.

methods.name: FT_List_Finalize
methods.description: Frees all nodes in the list and destroys it.
